newsitem.title: CHINA: China farmer kills self after wife has daughters.
newsitem.headline: China farmer kills self after wife has daughters.

text.p: A farmer in eastern China who attempted suicide after his wife gave birth to a daughter succeeded in taking his own life after the couple had another girl, a newspaper reported.

The farmer in Wangjiajing town in Zhejiang province, identified only by his surname Zhu, killed himself last month by drinking pesticide after his second child turned out to be a girl, the Nanjing Daily said in its Saturday edition.

"Zhu, heavily influenced by the feudal concept of regarding men as superior to women...felt ashamed to face his parents and that life was not worth living," said the newspaper, seen in Beijing on Monday.
Zhu, 36, had attempted suicide several years ago after his wife gave birth to their first child, also a daughter, the newspaper said.
Many Chinese prefer sons to daughters out of the traditional Confucian imperative that sons are necessary to carry on the family line.

Since Beijing adopted a strict birth control policy in the 1970s that imposes stiff fines on couples that have more than one child, many rural Chinese parents have gone to extreme measures, such as killing daughters in the hope the next child would be a son.
